title: 昭和校园
误会事件
episode: 第一话 · 天台的告白

F.name: 女老师
F.look: MISS RED: young Japanese female teacher, ~27, long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, pretty, wearing a red skirt suit (red jacket + red skirt). Expressive.

M.name: 志村
M.look: SHIMURA-SENSEI: middle-aged Japanese male teacher, ~45, short neat black hair parted to the side, thick black mustache, slightly droopy eyes, navy suit, white shirt, gray tie. Comedic, a bit pompous.

style:
STYLE: Japanese gag manga (1980s-90s comedy manga, like Kochikame / Saiki K). Bold black ink outlines, screentone halftone dots, speed lines, exaggerated comedic expressions. Limited palette: off-white paper #F7F3EA, black ink, and ONE accent color, manga red #E8322B. Otherwise grayscale screentone. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, no letters, no speech bubbles, no sound-effect lettering, no signatures, no watermarks anywhere in the image.
SETTING: rooftop of a Japanese high school in the Showa era: green chain-link fence, city skyline behind, yellow floor.

comedy.prompt: bouncy comedic cartoon music, pizzicato strings, bassoon, xylophone, playful sitcom, 120 bpm

romance.prompt: cheesy 1980s japanese idol drama romantic ballad, sparkling glockenspiel, lush soft strings, gentle electric piano, dreamy, over-the-top sweet, 80 bpm

scenes.art: Wide establishing shot on the school rooftop. MISS RED in the foreground, three-quarter back view, cupping one hand at her mouth calling out. SHIMURA-SENSEI small in the background near the fence, gazing at the skyline, hands behind his back.
Bust shot: SHIMURA-SENSEI turning his head back over his shoulder toward the viewer, eyebrows raised, curious blank expression. Chain-link fence and sky behind.
MISS RED blushing deeply, both hands clasped at her chest, eyes glancing shyly sideways, soft sparkle screentone background; SHIMURA-SENSEI visible beside her.
Extreme close-up of MISS RED's eyes only, filling the frame, trembling intense gaze, one big sweat drop, dramatic converging focus lines, heavy screentone.

Dramatic confession moment: MISS RED in upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, shouting passionately with fists clenched. Explosive red burst background. Lower-right: SHIMURA-SENSEI's face with giant red heart eyes and a nosebleed, jaw dropped in joy.

lines.text: 我喜欢您！非常非常喜欢！

scenes.art: SHIMURA-SENSEI with arms crossed, forcing a stern serious dignified face, sweat on his forehead, while behind him three tiny chibi versions of himself dance, cheer and throw confetti. MISS RED beside him.

lines.text: 咳，这种话……在学校里，不太合适吧。

dream.art: Dream fantasy vignette, soft sparkles: SHIMURA-SENSEI (idealized, handsome, sparkling) and MISS RED holding hands under a blooming cherry blossom tree, petals falling, romantic.

scenes.art: MISS RED leaning forward passionately, fists clenched in front of her chest, eyes shining with emotional tears, sparkly shoujo-manga flower background. SHIMURA-SENSEI listening, smug.

lines.text: 我不在乎别人怎么看！一想到您，我晚上都睡不着！

dream.art: Dream fantasy vignette, soft sparkles: church wedding, SHIMURA-SENSEI in a white tuxedo proudly smiling, MISS RED in a white wedding dress with veil, bells ringing, doves, confetti.

scenes.art: MISS RED hugging herself and twisting her body bashfully, eyes closed, cheeks red, surrounded by roses and small red hearts. SHIMURA-SENSEI standing nearby.

lines.text: 我知道神圣的学校不允许这样……可我，控制不住了！

dream.art: Dream fantasy vignette, soft sparkles: a big house with a white picket fence, SHIMURA-SENSEI grinning proudly with MISS RED, three small kids and a happy dog in front, sunshine.

scenes.art: MISS RED looking up to the sky in dreamy ecstasy, both hands on her cheeks, eyes sparkling, rays of light behind her. SHIMURA-SENSEI beside her.

lines.text: 好想被您抱在怀里……我愿意把一切都献给您！

scenes.art: SHIMURA-SENSEI still smiling but his smile has frozen stiff, one eyebrow twitching, a single sweat drop sliding down, a tiny hint of doubt in his eyes. MISS RED blushing next to him.

lines.text: 只要能和您在一起，我愿意退学！

scenes.art: Low-angle dynamic shot: SHIMURA-SENSEI leaping toward the viewer with arms wide open, ecstatic, slow-motion speed lines, sparkles. MISS RED in the lower-left foreground bowing deeply.

Quiet calm panel: MISS RED standing relaxed, holding up a pink letter envelope with a red heart seal next to her face, sweet innocent smile. SHIMURA-SENSEI arms still open. Simple plain background, lots of empty space, no effects.

lines.text: ——以上，是学生写给我的情书。念得怎么样？

scenes.art: SHIMURA-SENSEI completely petrified into gray stone, arms still stretched out, jaw dropped, blank white eyes, cracks running across his body, pieces crumbling, dark vertical lines of despair. Entire image grayscale, no red.

Wide rooftop shot: SHIMURA-SENSEI frozen like a gray stone statue with arms open on a pedestal on the left. MISS RED on the right walking away cheerfully, waving goodbye over her shoulder. A black crow flying across the sky, a few dry leaves blowing in the wind. Desolate.
